name: TANISHA KASHYAP
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: An athletic player with a strong serve, fluid movement, and a competitive baseline game, honed by her swimming background.
Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #875 (October 28, 2024), Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #1149 (March 17, 2025).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 1 ITF singles title (2024 Bengaluru W15, defeating Akanksha Nitture). College Success: Played at Ohio State University (2021-2023), earning Big Ten All-Freshman honors (2022) and a rare freshman starting spot. Junior Success: National U-14 and U-16 champion, represented India at Junior Billie Jean King Cup (2016), reached ITF Junior Top 300. Biggest Win: Defeated World No. 765 Akanksha Nitture at 2024 Bengaluru W15 final.
Other Highlights: Switched from competitive swimming (U-14 National breaststroke champion) to tennis at age 12. Delayed pro career due to COVID, turning pro in 2023 after completing her degree online. Aims for a Top 500 ranking by 2026.
Tanisha’s unique journey from swimmer to tennis pro showcases her versatility and determination. 🎾🇮🇳
